title: Attacks on Bamako a 'dramatic setback' for Malian government
summary: The coordinated attacks on Mali's capital of Bamako represent a "dramatic setback" for the junta-led government, said Andrew Lebovich, Research Fellow with Clingendael's Conflict Research Unit.
